source: Cloud Carbon Footprint (CCF) methodology, Appendix I
formula: Average Watts = Min Watts + Avg vCPU Utilization * (Max Watts - Min Watts); energy = (compute watts + memory watts) * hours * PUE
notes: Min/Max watts are CCF provider-wide averages across micro-architectures, per vCPU.
Memory coefficient is 0.000392 kWh per GB-hour, i.e. 0.392 W per GB allocated.
Azure PUE is 1.185 in the PUE section of the methodology and 1.125 in Appendix I; 1.185 is used here (the higher, conservative value). Sensitivity: results rank the same with 1.125.
All three clusters physically run on one EC2 host, so these coefficients model the REPRESENTED provider; they are not measurements of the host's hardware.
